description: This file defines JavaScript functions for a timer component within the ERPNext project, specifically for managing time logs in the timesheet module. It includes UI dialog creation, timer control, and interaction with form data.

methods.name: erpnext.timesheet.timer
methods.description: Initializes and displays a timer dialog for a timesheet row, allowing start and complete actions.

methods.name: erpnext.timesheet.control_timer
methods.description: Controls the timer's start, stop, and update functionalities, including UI updates and form data synchronization.
